title: Bugs to fix
text:
Hello Support Team,
I am really enjoying the app’s interface, but I’ve noticed two significant issues that make it difficult to manage my budget accurately:
1. Inaccurate Time Countdown: The app rounds down the weeks incorrectly. For example, if a payment is due in 10 days, the app only shows "1 week" instead of "1 week and 3 days." This lack of precision is confusing for deadlines that fall between 7 and 14 days. It would be much better if it showed the exact remaining days alongside the weeks.
2. Incorrect "Weekly Total" Calculation: The display for the total amount to be charged this week often shows $0 or an incorrect figure, even when I have multiple subscriptions due within the next 7 days. Ideally, this section should automatically sum every payment occurring in the upcoming week so I know exactly how much money will be debited from my account.
I hope you can look into these issues for the next update, as accurate weekly planning is essential for my financial tracking.
Thank you for your help!

title: Unfortunately misses a lot of UX features
text:
A couple of things that really prevent me from being able to use this app:
- no iPad version (others have pointed this out)
- no way to sort by the amount per month, rather than the “sticker price” (when a subscription is $10, that means nothing unless you have the time attached to it. But Bobby doesn’t take that into account for its functionalities other than adding)
- related to above, inability to “amortize” subscription costs: so many nowadays offer discounts for yearly subscriptions, but I need to be able to compare them in monthly costs

And perhaps worst of all: no support. I’ve reached out to the developer three times over this over the course of the years, no response. Really unfortunate.
